leadText:
Beach Rose Town (Japanese: ハマナスタウン Hamanasu Town) is an -exclusive location in Sinnoh. Like many other in the region, Beach Rose has its own Contest Hall, which makes it a popular destination among Pokémon Coordinators who plan on entering the Sinnoh Grand Festival.

A Pokémon Contest was held in Beach Rose Town, the result of which was reported during Marian's television show in A Breed Stampede!. Nando was revealed to have won the competition with the help of his , earning his fourth Ribbon.
